Währing (18. Bezirk) — Vienna, Austria

🟡 Local press research

Relatively safer day Relatively safer night

In detail

Währing is a quiet, largely residential district and press research found no pattern of street crime, drug dealing or tourist-targeted offences. Local crime statistics for 2021–2022 showed a 9.7% rise in recorded offences (2,513 to 2,758) and a 42.2% case-clearance rate — an increase, but notably smaller than Vienna's citywide 16.7% rise over the same period, meaning Währing's crime grew more slowly than the city average. The one serious documented incident is a single armed robbery at a Dorotheum branch on Währinger Straße on 7 August 2026, in which a masked, reportedly armed suspect fled empty-handed after a large police response; no injuries were reported and this reads as an isolated event rather than an ongoing pattern. No other safety-relevant incidents for pedestrians or visitors, day or night, turned up in the search. Sources checked: meinbezirk.at, "2021 und 2022 im Vergleich: Währing ist ein Stück krimineller geworden" (3 April 2023); meinbezirk.at, "Großeinsatz in Währing: Täter lässt Beute bei Dorotheum-Überfall zurück" (7 August 2026).
